# James Coombs

> Staff UX Engineer | Product Architecture, Design Systems, Web Performance & AI Developer Tooling.

## Context & Core Technical Focus
- **Product & Growth Engineering**: Architecting fast, data-driven web experiences that optimize conversion, SEO, and user engagement.
- **Platform & Developer Experience**: Building the infrastructure that lets engineering organizations ship faster, including automated component migration tooling and codified governance.
- **Design & Craft**: Scaling headless component systems (Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, Astro, React) and ensuring design intent survives implementation.
- **Performance Engineering**: DOM rendering optimizations, script execution reductions, and Core Web Vitals (INP, LCP) overhauls.

## Key Case Studies
- [SEO Landing Page Engine](https://james-coombs.com/case-studies/): Built a dynamic landing page generation engine using Next.js API routes, Algolia, Cloudinary, and GitLab CI/CD, automating the publishing of over 400 location-based landing pages with interactive enterprise chart and graph visualizations.
- [Cross-Session State Synchronization](https://james-coombs.com/case-studies/): Engineered a cross-session favoriting system using the BroadcastChannel API for real-time cross-tab synchronization and authenticated session merging, driving over 3,000 new user signups and 6,000 saved items in two months.
- [Signup Performance Overhaul](https://james-coombs.com/case-studies/): Split the signup webpack bundle, removed blocking dependencies, and established a frozen performance baseline. Drove signup LCP p75 from 9.8s down to 3.19s (-67%) with render delay from 8.4s to 2.6s, monitored via 7 RUM observability dashboards managed as code and 6 production alerts.
- [Design System and Migration Engine](https://james-coombs.com/case-studies/): Built a suite of 12 custom CLI tools, 48 JSON data files, and a 594-line playbook to automate a 962-file Material UI migration (cutting legacy MUI files from 999 to 792 and growing Design System files to 508, with 24 of 34 migration PRs authored by 4 peer engineers), alongside a 60-component design system across 14 versions. Purged legacy icons across 19 packages and 275 files (-18.7 MB unpacked, -19.3 MB packaged).

## Other Infrastructure & Tooling
- [Agentic AI Governance Layer](https://james-coombs.com/blog/ai-agent-safety-architecture/): Codified safety system for AI agents enforcing runtime hooks across 1,802 lines and 13 scripts, backed by 219 tests and 1,251 manual approvals after an n=9 ablation study proved 0% compliance on passive written rules.
- [Internal AI Developer Marketplace & Automated Blast-Radius CI](https://james-coombs.com/resume/#rev): Served as #1 human contributor (219 commits, 33 PRs authored, 26 merged) to the org-wide Claude Code platform auto-installed for every engineer, shipping 2 foundation plugins depended on by 3 other teams' plugins and a 4-stage full-stack C#/GraphQL/React workflow. Built an automated TypeScript UX Review CI pipeline with Nx reverse-dependency blast-radius scoring on every frontend monorepo PR, cutting false-positive rates from 9% to near zero.
- [High-Performance Transcript Rendering Engine](https://james-coombs.com/resume/#rev): Cut Transcript Editor interaction latency (INP p98) from 2,169ms down to 112ms (-95%) on 4.5-hour files, reducing style recalculations from 57,000 to 9,500 elements.
